story.heading: Your space to build in Haridwar.
body: Palm City is a residential plotted development at IP-2, near Danco Chowk in Salempur Mahdood, Haridwar. The township offers four plot-size options, from 100 to 300 square yards.
Its project website lists gated access, internal roads, landscaped parks and utility connections. Choose a plot size to suit your home plans and arrange a visit to explore the development.

body: Vantara Farms offers 31 constructed farm houses in Phase 1, each on a 5,400 sq ft plot. Developed by GARVIT INFRA CONSTRUCTIONS LLP, the project combines private homes with shared leisure and wellness facilities.
The development has a 40 ft entry road and 30 ft internal roads. Its location near Haridwar offers access towards Najibabad and Kotdwar, with green surroundings and space for outdoor living.

story.heading: Your plans. Your plot. Your next address.
body: Palm Street Phase 02 is a plotted residential development at IP-2 SIDCUL, near Denso Chowk in Haridwar. The supplied project content describes approximately 5.12 acres of planned development, with plots measuring 880, 950, 1,000, 1,170 and 1,350 sq ft.

The supplied brochure information lists the project as under construction. Its location in the SIDCUL corridor provides access towards shopping, residential neighbourhoods and major Haridwar destinations.
The listed rate is ₹3,977 per sq ft, with a ₹1,00,000 booking amount. Pricing, availability, approvals and possession timing should be confirmed with the project sales team.

Haridwar Bus Stand, Har Ki Pauri, Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi Temple and Crystal World are also listed as accessible destinations.
